notes.title: SP:WS v1.01 Update
notes.notes:
Senpai Puzzle: Waifu Summer v1.01 is live now!

Features & improvements include:


 Improved Waifu Quality - Your 4k Waifus look even better with compression issues fixed for all Waifus.
 DLC Handling/ Ram Usage Update - The way DLC is handled has been re-written. DLC loading is slightly faster; but most importantly Ram usage is now around 2GB compared to the almost 4GB it used to use! After SP:WS has finished loading, Ram usage is less than 1GB! 
 DLC Size Updates - All DLC has been updated and now all DLC files are smaller taking up less of your HDD!


Cheers.

Kink Master Studios/Takeover Studios.
